references.text: Kedesh is mentioned as one of the cities conquered by Joshua and refers to the same city assigned to the tribe of Naphtali.
Kedesh in Galilee was designated as one of the cities of refuge in the hill country of Naphtali, confirming the city's importance within the tribe's territory.
Kedesh in Galilee with its pasturelands was given to the Levites from the tribe of Naphtali, the same city mentioned here.
Barak was called from Kedesh in Naphtali to fight against Sisera, showing the city's continued significance in the tribe's history.
Kedesh was among the cities conquered by Tiglath-Pileser, king of Assyria, during Pekah's time, illustrating the city's fate in later history.
Edrei was a city in the kingdom of Og of Bashan, and the name may be connected to Edrei mentioned in Naphtali's territory.
